meta.title: Mia's Day
meta.textType: functional: a daily routine by the clock

paragraphs: It is six o'clock in the morning. The clock in Mia's bedroom says six. Mia gets up. She is happy. At seven o'clock, Mia eats breakfast in the kitchen. She has an egg, rice, and juice. At eight o'clock, she goes to school. Mia is seven. Mia has a red bag. Her bag is big.

At twelve o'clock, Mia eats lunch with Lily. Lily is her friend. They have rice and fruit. "Can we play now?" asks Lily. "Yes, we can!" says Mia. In the afternoon, Mia goes to the garden. At four o'clock, she plays with Pip. Pip is Tom and Lily's dog. Mia loves animals. "Do you want the ball, Pip?" asks Mia. "Woof!" says Pip. Pip is happy.

It is the evening. At six o'clock, Mia eats dinner with her family. Then she looks at the clock. "Is it eight o'clock?" asks Mia. "Yes, it is," says Mom. "Go to bed, Mia." Mia goes to bed. "Good night, Mom." At nine o'clock, she goes to sleep. Today is a happy day for Mia.
text.summary: Mia tells us about her day by the clock. She gets up at six o'clock and goes to sleep at nine o'clock.
